raw_topology.method: Read raw binary records; exact float-coordinate deduplication only, no tolerance welding or repair. Each edge must have two oppositely directed uses, and each vertex link must be one cycle.

all_triangle_exact_self_intersections.method: Original float32 STL coordinates converted exactly to dyadic integer coordinates with one common power-of-two denominator. Every inclusive-AABB candidate tested again with unbounded Python integer signed-plane predicates. Noncoplanar triangle/plane intervals constructed and compared with exact fractions; coplanar triangles intersected by exact-fraction Sutherland-Hodgman clipping in dominant 2D projection. Only an intersection confined exactly to the actual shared STL vertex/edge is allowed. No epsilon is used in exact refinement; the inclusive floating AABB broad phase is conservative for the same finite input coordinates.
all_triangle_exact_self_intersections.limits: Exact arithmetic applies only to triangle self-intersections of the quantized binary STL. It is custom code with numerical controls and a separately implemented floating cross-check, not a formally verified geometry library. It does not validate architecture, slicer paths, feature strength, supports or physical printing.

centroid_ray_summary.method: Every original raw face centroid and inward normal, Moller-Trumbore intersection against all other triangles. No origin displacement, tangential offset or changed ray. Strict barycentric zero comparison retained; inclusive 1e-12 barycentric comparison is separately reported for the identical ray. Normal determinant threshold 1e-12; exclude t<=1e-8mm for starting-surface roundoff. Centroid sampling cannot certify arbitrary-point thickness.

limits: Exact arithmetic is for self-intersections of quantized STL triangles; custom reviewer code is controlled but not formally verified.
Exact Fraction section endpoints retain raw coordinates and plane values; GEOS polygon and morphology operations remain double precision.
Face-centroid rays do not establish arbitrary-point minimum wall thickness. All strict misses and independent same-ray barycentric supplements are retained.
No material strength, adhesion, physical fit, glue-gap tolerance, pillar bending strength, support removal or real-print validation.
Assembly expected contacts and micro-overlaps are reviewed separately in assembly-* reports. No press-fit or zero-error mating certificate is implied.
